item.description: - **Translation into English.** Dictate in any language and get English text. Translate on your Mac with Apple Intelligence or macOS Translation, or online with your own OpenAI or Groq key. If a dictation can't be translated, it still arrives as you said it, with the reason shown under the text. - **Online services in Settings → Models.** Connect Groq or OpenAI once, add your key, and choose them for recognition, translation, or both. - **Settings rearranged** into General, Dictation, Recognition, and Models. Ready models and translators are marked with a green check. - **Paste access in one row.** Both permissions Quoth needs for pasting are requested from a single row, and you can turn off putting your clipboard back after a paste. - **Check for updates** now lives in Settings → General.
